title: Activity Inspector: pivoted smart-filters, RBAC-aware exports, and async bundled CSV/JSON download
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Problem: Security and compliance teams need a single console experience that lets them slice and export large audit datasets for investigations while respecting RBAC v2 and customer privacy. Current viewer is slow for broad queries, lacks pivoted facets, and exports time out or require manual chunking.

Goal: Deliver a performant 'Activity Inspector' in the Console that supports: smart, pivoted filters; cursor-based async pagination; RBAC-aware column masking (sensitive fields masked unless admin has permissions); user-initiated bundled exports (multi-file ZIP containing CSV and NDJSON) with server-side job queue and approval workflow for exports >100k rows; and saved-query matrix with team-level sharing and access controls.

Non-goals: Full ELK/BigQuery migration, replacing underlying store, or building complex data warehouse UIs. This ticket scopes the Console UX + server export job API and RBAC enforcement; infra scaling will be handled in follow-ups if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows pivoted facets (actor, action, resource_type, region, outcome) and supports adding multiple facets simultaneously
Search supports mixed full-text + structured predicates and returns cursor tokens for paginated traversal (no offset-based paging)
Export flow creates an async job for any download that would exceed 10k rows; jobs appear in a user-visible Jobs panel with status and download link
Exports use RBAC v2 to determine which columns are visible; masked columns are replaced with '<REDACTED>' when user lacks permission
Large exports bundle files into a single ZIP containing per-day CSV slices and an NDJSON canonical export; generated files pass a schema validation job (same schema as audit event payloads)
Saved queries can be named, described, and shared with team/organization; sharing respects RBAC (only owners or admins can modify/delete)
Admin-only exports (sensitive-scoped) require a second-factor approval step in the UI and emit an approval event to the audit log
Performance: typical filtered query (30–90s window, 1M tokens of events) returns first page within 2s under p95 load on staging cluster
E2E tests cover filter combinations, export job lifecycle, RBAC masking, saved-query permissions, and approval flow
comments: 2026-02-12 Sofia Chen: Created ticket after request from Compliance. Attached initial design intent and compliance checklist.

2026-02-16 Mateo Ruiz: Spike completed — built proof-of-concept for cursor-based paging using cursor token from search index. Found that naive prefix caching for KV hits causes inconsistency with live tail; will add generation-based invalidation. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/17482

2026-02-20 Priya Malhotra (Product): Design review notes: prefer per-facet typeahead and persistent facet order. PM asks to include an example saved-query template for incident triage. See Figma: https://figma.com/file/ABC123/activity-inspector

2026-02-24 Security Review (Carlos Ortega): RBAC masking approach approved pending two changes: (1) redact token_id and ip_address by default, (2) require explicit 'export_sensitive' permission for NDJSON canonical exports. Security requested audit events emitted for every export approval. Added security_review_required flag.

2026-02-26 Design (Lina Park): UX tweak accepted — admin approval dialog should show a preview (first 10 rows) with masked columns annotated and link to policy. UX will show estimated file size before job creation.

2026-02-28 Mateo Ruiz: Implementation update — backend job queue (kafka->worker) wired, export generator streaming into S3 multipart and emits signed URL. Edge case: extremely wide events (huge metadata arrays) cause CSV field overflow. Decision: truncate long string fields at 64k and emit 'truncated' column with original byte count. Logged GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/56321
2026-03-01 QA (Daniel Kim): Started integration tests; found permissions regression where shared saved queries were visible but not executable by read-only teammates. Patch queued in PR 17540.
